findings.title: is_sha256 accepted a single trailing newline via $ regex anchor
findings.body: Fixed by switching from re.compile(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$') + .match() to an anchor-free pattern with .fullmatch(). Independently verified: PASS, 0 risks, byte-verified hash recomputation of primitives.py (3d79cd0a66811524886f6e7c7c9898256c1b067b88f7081237530c5dc679c938) matched local shasum.

fixes_applied: src/dopemux/uag/primitives.py: is_sha256 uses fullmatch() on an anchor-free pattern instead of match() on ^...$
